description: Nonresistant submerged floor-trap trigger emits bubbles, retains slime and maximum HP, and applies rnd(3) boiling-water damage.
Fire-resistant submerged floor-trap trigger emits bubbles and uninjured feedback, retaining HP and slime without shield animation.
Dry water-elemental floor-trap trigger retains ordinary fire consequences and clears slime.
Dry iron-golem floor-trap trigger retains ordinary resistant fire consequences and clears slime.
Blind submerged look does not trigger the unseen fire trap; timed slime decreases with elapsed turns.
Sighted submerged look does not trigger the unseen fire trap and consumes no time or action RNG.
